title: Strings Advanced: Manacher, Z / Hashing, Palindromic Structures
relevance: Medium (LPS / “is substring a palindrome?” show up in OAs via expand-around-center or hash; full Manacher, Z-period tricks, and k-palindrome DP are mainly CF rating builders toward ~2100)
company_notes: Longest palindromic substring / count palindromic substrings — expand-around-center is the interview default; Manacher or hash+BS is the CP upgrade when n hits 10^6 (CSES / CF D2). Make-a-palindrome with fewest front inserts / prefix+suffix keep — Shortest Palindrome / Prefix-Suffix Palindrome in timed OAs; KMP on s#rev(s) or Manacher on the middle. Is this range a palindrome after edits — forward/reverse hash with updates (CSES Palindrome Queries). Contest Div. 2 D/E stretch: k-palindrome counts, Z-password borders, compress-on-overlap merges.

phases.goal: Map longest/count/query palindrome wording, prefix+suffix builds, and large-n period asks to Manacher, hash palindrome checks, or Z/π tools.

must_hit.point: Longest / count / queries of palindromic substrings signal expand-around-center in interviews, or Manacher / hash+BS when n is too large for quadratic expand.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Names LPS/count/query-palindrome cues and upgrades from expand to Manacher or hash+BS under large n.

must_hit.point: Prefix+suffix palindrome builds (keep matching shell, extend the middle) signal Prefix-Suffix Palindrome / Shortest Palindrome style — KMP on s#rev(s) or Manacher/hash on the middle.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Describes peel matching prefix+suffix then longest palindromic middle extension.

must_hit.point: “Is s[l..r] a palindrome?” especially after point edits signals forward/reverse rolling hashes (plus Fenwick/seg for updates), not rebuild-from-scratch.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Maps range palindrome queries (± updates) to the forward/reverse hash black box.

must_hit.point: Longest border that is also an interior occurrence, glue-on-overlap merges, or (AB)^kA-style prefixes signal Z/π period tools (Password / Prefixes-and-Suffixes / necklace).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Ties Password-style interior border, overlap merge, and necklace period forms to Z/π.

probes: What wording pushes you from expand-around-center to Manacher, hash palindrome checks, or Z/π period tools?
Is this LPS/count, prefix+suffix keep, range palindrome after edits, or a border/period constraint?

hints.1: Listen for palindromic substrings, prefix+suffix keep, range palindrome after edits, or border/period with large n.
hints.2: LPS/count/queries → expand or Manacher/hash; prefix+suffix shell → KMP/Manacher middle; range±edits → forward/reverse hash; interior border/overlap/(AB)^kA → Z/π.
hints.3: Say: longest/count/query pals → expand default, Manacher or hash+BS when n too large for O(n^2); prefix+suffix keep → peel shell then Manacher/hash middle (or KMP on s#rev(s)); range pal after edits → forward/reverse hash (+Fenwick); Password/overlap/necklace → Z/π.

phases.goal: State the linear all-centers, hash palindrome black box, prefix–suffix peel, and Z/k-palindrome plans before coding.

must_hit.point: Under large n, replace O(n^2) expand with a linear all-centers tool: Manacher d_odd/d_even (or #-joined odd-only), or hash + binary search per center.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Rejects quadratic expand and names Manacher radii or hash+BS per center.

must_hit.point: Forward + reverse prefix hashes give an O(1) palindrome black box: s[l..r] is a palindrome iff hash(l,r) equals hash_rev of the mirrored reverse range.
must_hit.evidence_hint: States forward/reverse hash equality as the range-palindrome test.

must_hit.point: Prefix–suffix palindrome: peel the matching shell, then Manacher/hash the remaining middle from both ends (1326D1/D2).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Plans shell peel then linear palindrome tool on the middle.

must_hit.point: Higher structure: k-palindrome degree if a palindrome’s left half is (k−1)-pal (835D/7D); for n≤5000, isPal[l][r] from shorter lengths then 2D prefix sums (245H).
must_hit.evidence_hint: States k-pal recurrence and the n≤5000 isPal+2D-prefix count plan.

probes: How do you get all centers or O(1) range-palindrome checks without O(n^2) expand?
For prefix+suffix keep vs k-palindrome counts vs Password borders, what is the plan?

hints.1: Pick all-centers, hash black box, shell-peel, or Z/k-pal from the ask.
hints.2: Large n → Manacher or hash+BS; range pal → forward/reverse hash; 1326 → peel then middle; k-pal / 245H → degree DP or isPal+prefix.
hints.3: Say: Manacher d_odd/d_even (or hash+BS per center) instead of O(n^2) expand; forward/reverse hash for O(1) is-pal; peel matching shell then Manacher/hash middle; k-pal if half is (k−1)-pal; n≤5000 → isPal then 2D prefix.

phases.goal: Build Manacher radii, forward/reverse hash (with Fenwick updates), prefix–suffix peel, and the core Z/k-palindrome checks.

must_hit.point: Manacher template: compute d_odd[i] / d_even[i] (or #-joined odd-only) in O(n); recover LPS and longest palindrome centered at i.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Sketches odd/even (or joined) radii and reads LPS / per-center length from them.

must_hit.point: Palindrome black box: s[l..r] is a palindrome iff hash(l,r) = hash_rev(n−r+1, n−l+1) in O(1) after forward and reverse prefix hashes.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Writes the mirrored reverse-index equality exactly.

must_hit.point: For point updates + range palindrome queries, maintain hashes in a Fenwick/segtree; never rebuild O(n) hashes per query (CSES Palindrome Queries).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Puts forward/reverse hash under Fenwick/seg and rejects per-query full rebuild.

must_hit.point: Z/π Password pattern: longest string that is prefix, suffix, and occurs strictly inside; period i holds iff hash-blocks of length i match.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Requires interior occurrence beyond a plain border, and block-hash period checks.

probes: Walk through Manacher radii and the forward/reverse hash palindrome test.
How do you handle hash updates, the 1326 middle, or the Password interior-border condition?

hints.1: Start from d_odd/d_even and the reverse-hash index formula.
hints.2: Manacher O(n) radii → LPS; hash(l,r)=hash_rev(n−r+1,n−l+1); Fenwick for updates; Password needs interior Z hit; periods via equal blocks.
hints.3: Spell: d_odd/d_even (or # join) in O(n); is-pal iff forward hash equals reverse mirrored range; Fenwick/seg hash updates; peel shell then Manacher/hash middle; longest border with strict interior occurrence; period iff length-i blocks match.

phases.goal: Confirm when O(n)/O(1) palindrome tools beat O(n^2) expand and when n≤5000 DP is allowed.

must_hit.point: Manacher runs in O(n); forward/reverse hashes answer “is s[l..r] a palindrome?” in O(1) after precompute — required when n hits 10^6 instead of O(n^2) expand.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Contrasts O(n) Manacher and O(1) hash checks with quadratic expand at n≤10^6.

must_hit.point: Dynamic palindrome queries must not rebuild O(n) hashes per query; use Fenwick/seg hash updates.
must_hit.evidence_hint: States per-query rebuild is wrong and names Fenwick/seg maintenance.

must_hit.point: Range palindrome-count DP with isPal[l][r] + 2D prefix fits when n≤5000; n≤5·10^6 pal-degree forces pure hash (7D).
must_hit.evidence_hint: Separates the n≤5000 DP regime from the pure-hash large-n regime.

probes: What is the cost of Manacher vs expand, and of a hash palindrome check after precompute?
When is isPal DP acceptable, and when must you refuse O(n) rebuilds per query?

hints.1: Separate precompute cost from per-check cost, and DP-sized n from 10^6-scale n.
hints.2: Manacher O(n); hash is-pal O(1); no O(n) rebuild per query; isPal OK at n≤5000; 7D needs pure hash.
hints.3: Say: Manacher O(n) and O(1) forward/reverse is-pal when n hits 10^6, not O(n^2) expand; Fenwick/seg instead of rebuilding O(n) hashes; isPal+2D prefix at n≤5000; n≤5·10^6 pal-degree → pure hash.

phases.goal: Catch quadratic expand on large n, hash rebuilds, missing reverse indices, and Password borders without interior hits.

must_hit.point: Using O(n^2) expand-around-center when n≤10^6 (CSES Longest Palindrome / CF 1326D2) instead of Manacher or hash+BS.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Flags quadratic expand as failing the linear-n palindrome milestones.

must_hit.point: Rebuilding O(n) forward/reverse hashes after each point update instead of Fenwick/seg maintenance.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Requires dynamic hash structure, not full recomputation per update/query.

must_hit.point: Checking only that a candidate is a border (prefix=suffix) for Password without requiring a strict interior occurrence.
must_hit.evidence_hint: Insists on prefix+suffix+inside, not border alone.

must_hit.point: Forgetting the mirrored reverse indices in the hash palindrome test (must compare hash(l,r) to hash_rev(n−r+1, n−l+1)).

probes: What fails at n≤10^6 if you only expand around centers?
Where do Password and dynamic palindrome-query solutions usually go wrong?

hints.1: Check expand vs linear tools, hash rebuilds, reverse indices, and interior borders.
hints.2: Large n needs Manacher/hash+BS; updates need Fenwick; Password needs inside occurrence; is-pal needs mirrored rev hash.
hints.3: Say: no O(n^2) expand at n≤10^6; Fenwick/seg not O(n) rebuild; Password = longest prefix=suffix that occurs strictly inside; is-pal iff hash(l,r)=hash_rev(n−r+1,n−l+1).

tradeoffs.strong_answer: Expand-around-center is the interview default for LPS / count palindromic substrings; when n hits 10^6 (CSES / CF D2), upgrade to Manacher d_odd/d_even or hash + binary search per center instead of O(n^2) expand.

tradeoffs.topic: Manacher radii vs forward/reverse hash black box
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Manacher computes all center radii in O(n) for LPS and per-center lengths; forward+reverse hashes answer arbitrary “is s[l..r] a palindrome?” in O(1), and with Fenwick/seg support point updates (CSES Palindrome Queries).
When n≤5000, precompute isPal[l][r] from shorter lengths then 2D prefix sums for range palindrome counts (245H). When n≤10^6, use Manacher or hash; n≤5·10^6 pal-degree (7D) forces pure hash.

tradeoffs.topic: KMP on s#rev(s) vs Manacher/hash on the middle
tradeoffs.strong_answer: Prefix+suffix keep / Shortest Palindrome: peel the matching shell, then either KMP on s#rev(s) or Manacher/hash the remaining middle from both ends (1326D1/D2); hard version forces a linear palindrome tool.

gotchas.trap: Expanding around every center in O(n^2) when constraints are n≤10^6.
gotchas.correction: Use Manacher (d_odd/d_even or #-joined) or hash + binary search per center — the linear all-centers tool required by CSES Longest Palindrome / CF 1326D2.

gotchas.trap: Rebuilding the whole forward/reverse hash arrays after each edit.
gotchas.correction: Maintain hashes in a Fenwick or segment tree so point updates stay cheap and range palindrome checks stay O(1) black-box style (CSES Palindrome Queries).

gotchas.trap: Answering Password with the longest border alone.
gotchas.correction: The string must be a prefix, a suffix, and occur strictly inside; use Z/π (or hash+BS) for that interior occurrence.

gotchas.trap: Testing palindrome ranges with only a forward hash.
gotchas.correction: Compare hash(l,r) to hash_rev(n−r+1, n−l+1) after building both forward and reverse prefix hashes.

gotchas.trap: Treating Manacher output as only an LPS length when the task reconstructs the string.
gotchas.correction: Radii are equality constraints between mirrored positions — build the lex-smallest S (or prove impossible) from the given odd radii (ABC349 G stretch).
